purpose: Teach: 貴文/幸雄/十郎/洋一/博之/一夫/僕達/がわり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの貴文と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Takafumi from the next class over.
lines.style: Light, observant tone with a hint of teasing. Casual directness — she's noticed something small and is calling him on it. Relaxed posture, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、幸雄さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your dad's name is Yukio, right? Sakura?
lines.style: Turned back on her, calm and deliberate. No edge, just matching her observation with his own. Slight pause before the name, like he's making a point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で源義経の弟、十郎さん習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you learn about Yoshitsune's younger brother, Juro, in social studies?
lines.style: Same teasing quality, but escalating — she's enjoying this game. Words come quicker now, a little lift in the attack. Still cool on the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、洋一兄さんと家庭科で一緒だったろ、桜
lines.en: You were in home economics with your older brother Yoichi, weren't you?
lines.style: Following her rhythm, his volleys getting sharper. Quieter delivery but with precision. Slight smile underneath — he's matching her beat now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、博之先輩を尊敬してたな
lines.en: Riku, you really looked up to your senior Hiroshi.
lines.style: Pushing a little harder now, her teasing has warmth underneath. The words land with just a touch more weight — she's testing if he'll admit something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、一夫おじさんと話してたな、桜
lines.en: I heard you talking to your Uncle Kazuo at the cafeteria.
lines.style: Levelling the ground, calm and knowing. Not accusatory — just stating what he knows. The delivery is almost gentle, which makes it hit more.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭で「僕達のクラスは最高」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, at the culture festival you said 'our class is the best.'
lines.style: The pace quickens, she's building to something. Softer now, less teasing — she's revealing that she was paying attention to him. Slight vulnerability underneath the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、食堂で「日がわり弁当」のひがわり頼んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were always ordering the daily special bento at the cafeteria, Sakura.
lines.style: Final volley, quieter and slower than before. He's not teasing anymore — he's saying 'I saw you too.' The intimacy of noticing small, everyday things. Warm and unguarded.
